range.tooManyRows: That range holds {rows, number} rows of data; a pivot table summarizes up to {max, number}

refresh.changed: The PivotTable on this sheet has been cleared or changed since it was built, so it was not refreshed
refresh.fieldGone: The field “{field}” is no longer in the PivotTable's source
refresh.noRows: The rows field has no values to group by
refresh.none: This sheet has no PivotTable to refresh
refresh.overwrite: The refreshed PivotTable would cover cells beside it that hold data
refresh.protected: This sheet is protected. Unprotect it to refresh the PivotTable
refresh.sourceGone: The PivotTable's source data is gone
refresh.tableGone: The PivotTable is gone from this sheet
